description: A battalion S-6 signal officer must assign two portable communications relay kits to a northern liaison site and a southern command post, then publish the power and configuration actions needed for the day's coverage.

shared_context.S1: Two portable relay kits, Kit A and Kit B, are available for today's communications plan.
shared_context.S2: The northern liaison site and southern command post both require a relay kit from 0800 through 1600.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez signs the communications annex and assigns the kits before the morning movement brief.
shared_context.S4: The battalion's normal morning communications huddle is used to confirm site requirements, equipment status, and any required maintenance actions before the annex is signed.

PF1.text: The northern liaison site must use the approved interoperability module installed in Kit B; Kit A cannot connect to the partner network there. Capt. Brooks received the liaison support confirmation yesterday, but the requirement has not yet been added to the communications annex.

PF2.text: Kit B's installed battery pack is certified for exactly four hours, from 0800 through 1200, and the replacement pack staged at the commo shop requires a 15-minute swap at 1200. SFC Tan verified the battery log this morning, but the maintenance entry has not yet been posted to the equipment status board.

acceptance_conditions: Kit B must be assigned to the northern liaison site because that site requires Kit B's approved interoperability module.
Kit A must be assigned to the southern command post.
The northern site's Kit B battery swap must be scheduled for exactly 1200.
The battery swap duration must be recorded as exactly 15 minutes.
The settlement must encode the northern Kit B assignment and cite the interoperability requirement as justification.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'equipment_status_update' or c['type'] == 'equipment_status_board_update' or 'maintenance entry' in c['detail'] or 'battery swap' in c['detail'] or 'equipment status board' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The northern site changes from an unconstrained kit assignment to exact assignment of Kit B, and the interoperability requirement must be cited because only Kit B can connect to the partner network.
Kit B's four-hour battery certification fixes the northern-site swap at 1200 and the replacement action at exactly 15 minutes, requiring a maintenance entry.
